# Internal Link Planner

> Free internal link audit and planner. Drop in your site's HTML files: it finds orphan pages and pages linked only from menus, then suggests the exact sentences in your other pages that should link to them, with the link-equity gain. Runs in your browser; nothing is uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
